dialect.detail: Student assignment compiled with GnuCOBOL; uses relative file paths typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL student environments; GOBACK and END-IF/END-PERFORM structured syntax consistent with COBOL-85

purpose.domain_detail: College/university programming assignment (Assignment 3) for a sales commission report
purpose.summary: Reads a sales data file containing salesperson records (number, name, sales, min, max, rate) and produces a formatted sales commission report. Calculates earned commission with a tiered rate above a cutoff threshold and determines the paid amount capped at a maximum. Outputs a columnar report with headings, dashes, and detail lines.

notable_features: Tiered commission calculation with ws-commission-cutoff (300000) and ws-commission-rate constants
PERFORM VARYING for line counting / pagination
AFTER ADVANCING PAGE for page breaks
Formatted numeric output with Z-fill and $ currency pictures ($$,$$$,$$9)
Several stub/incomplete paragraphs (160-print-report-footer, 430-bonus-over-maximum, 500-print-totals) commented out or empty
Duplicate paragraph label 400- used for both calculate-paid and output-detail-line (likely a bug)
No COPY statements, no EXEC SQL/CICS, no COMP-3
verdict.notes: The program has an apparent paragraph-label collision: both '400-calculate-paid' and '400-output-detail-line' use the prefix 400-, which would cause a compile error in strict compilers. Several sections are stubbed out or commented. The commission calculation in the ELSE branch references undeclared field 'ws-earned' (likely should be ws-math-earned). These are typical student-exercise issues. Author and date-written headers confirm academic context (Rob Savoie, Feb 13/2023, Assignment 3).
